notes.title: New version of Elven Love is available!
notes.content:
Hello!
Elven Love has been updated. We've got a new intro with proper introduction to the game and more. Hope you'll like the stuff!

Changes:
 Intro with proper introduction to the story added
 Main tutorial updated - it now explains controls, wands and quests
 Ending scene updated to suit the overall story
 Fixed fingers stretching bug with some poses and animations
 Fixed the bug with enabling/disabling clothes option after undressing both the Elves 
 
Thank you for all the support! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Ending, Voices and More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We're back with an update to Elven Love that includes new ending experience and elves voiceovers.
Hope you'll like what we've prepared for you!

List of changes:

 Ending experience completely reworked!
 Elves now have voice-overs and talk to the player!
 New puzzle added to the third scene
 Elves reactions have been improved
 Lighting bug fixed
 Some models optimized
 Fixed bug of several objects affecting teleportation

We're working on some sweet stuff right now... more information coming soon!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31959183/5b76515db8728cbb9ac4d44a794809c08a2ada19.png

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello, we're back with another update to Elven Love.
Here's the list of changes:

 Player rotation option added to the menu - Thumbstick for Oculus and Touchpad for Vive
 Fixed collisions for some of the objects
 Interactions and picking up items improved, objects handling unified
 Lost objects now move back to initial location.
 Options panel tweaked

More coming soon!

notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
Hello!
We are really sorry for the release date postponement. We've encountered some Steam related problems. The delay gives us more time for improvements and will positively affect the game.

The final release date for Elven Love is 16.03.2018!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31959183/def2fcad23cf1187adba5edd0b4d46314d2cc944.png

We are working hard to deliver the best quality. 
Thank you for your patience.
